owner.label: Owner
owner.blurb: Everything, including deleting bills, locking months and managing users.

accountant.label: Accountant
accountant.blurb: Sees everything, books purchase bills, files GST and locks months. Can't change or delete sales bills.

staff.label: Counter staff
staff.blurb: Makes and sends bills, books purchase bills, adds customers and sets today's rates. Can't delete or file.

viewer.label: View only
viewer.blurb: Can look at everything and download reports. Changes nothing.
